purpose: Reference points for reading the in-training convergence probes.
why_this_file_exists: Probes call evaluate_model(), which shares the protocol's episode loop but does not load the model inside the seeded region, so its numbers are NOT bit-comparable with evaluate(). A probe value during the run is therefore meaningless against the authoritative 89.2% figure. What it can be read against is what the SAME probe path reports for the STARTING checkpoint, at the SAME seed. That is what this file records.

7.note: Seed 7 is the probe/selection seed used by train_phase9.py. THIS is the like-for-like reference for reading run probes.

42.note: Seed 42 is reserved for the final authoritative eval and is NOT used for probes, to keep checkpoint selection off the reported episodes. Recorded here only to show the seed-to-seed spread at n=100, which is itself worth knowing: 3pp of goal rate and 2.8pp of intervention rate between two seeds on identical weights.
